title: Consultation activity
$comment: Derived by the API Evangelist enrichment pipeline from openapi/uk-caa-consultations-api-openapi.yml, itself transcribed verbatim from the CAA's published API reference at https://consultations.caa.co.uk/api/2.4/ and cross-checked against a live anonymous response. The UK CAA publishes no JSON Schema of its own. Derived 2026-07-28.
description: A published consultation or engagement activity. Field groups follow the `fields` parameter: basic fields are always present, fields marked extended require fields=extended or above, fields marked all require fields=all.

startdate.description: The date the activity opens / opened on (observed format yyyy/mm/dd)

enddate.description: The date the activity closes / closed on (observed format yyyy/mm/dd)

workspace_title.description: The title of the workspace that the activity belongs to (extended and above)

workspace_id.description: The ID of the workspace that the activity belongs to (extended and above)

department.description: (deprecated) The name of the department that the activity belongs to (extended and above)

dept.description: (deprecated) The ID of the department that the activity belongs to (extended and above)

type_string.description: Human readable activity type (extended and above)

participate_url.description: The direct URL to the participation method (survey etc), skipping the overview page (extended and above). The published reference names this field `participation_url`; the live 2.4 response emits `participate_url` — verified 2026-07-28.

progress.description: The current state of the activity (extended and above)

visibility.description: Either 'public' or 'private' depending on if the activity has been hidden from end users (extended and above)

why.description: The contents of the 'why are we consulting?' field (all only)

what_happens_next.description: The contents of the 'what happens next?' field (all only)

feedbackdate.description: The date that activity feedback is/was expected (all only)

resultdate.description: The date that activity results are/were expected (all only). The published reference names this field `resultsdate`; the live 2.4 response emits `resultdate` — verified 2026-07-28.

contact_name.description: The full name entered in the activity's contact details (all only)

contact_jobtitle.description: The job title entered in the activity's contact details (all only)

contact_team.description: The team name entered in the activity's contact details (all only)

contact_phone.description: The phone number entered in the activity's contact details (all only)

contact_email.description: The email address entered in the activity's contact details (all only)

related_links.description: A list of related links (all only)

related_consultations.description: A list of related activities (all only)

supporting_documents.description: A list of supporting documents (all only)

audiences.description: A list of audiences this activity applies to (all only)

areas.description: A list of ids for areas this activity applies to. NB: This field is omitted unless area support is installed (all only)

interests.description: A list of ids for interests this activity applies to (all only)

x-required-note: The API declares no required fields. Every field above was present on all 294 activities in the live corpus except optional arrays and the 'all'-tier fields; no required[] is asserted here because the provider asserts none.
